patthana21.46:1.1: Naāsavaṃ nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca noāsavo sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Ekaṃ.
patthana21.46:2.1: Nanoāsavaṃ nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca noāsavo sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Ekaṃ. Gaṇitakena tīṇi.
patthana21.46:3.1: Noāsavaṃ naanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca… (purimanayena tīṇi pañhā).
patthana21.46:4.1: Noāsavaṃ naanidassanaappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca noāsavo anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
